record.text:
The Lakers are 9-2 and Austin Reaves had 43 points.

No Luka Dončić on Sunday night? No problem.

The Lakers take down the Detroit Pistons on their one visit to Michigan this season. 

They face the Atlanta Hawks tomorrow night.

Final:
Lakers 121
Pistons 116

Despite no Luka Dončić, the Lakers never trailed against the Pistons, winning 121-116. Austin Reaves had 43 points, his fourth-highest-scoring game ever. Ziaire Williams had 17 points, and Jarred Vanderbilt grabbed 10 boards in his 14 minutes. LA will take on Atlanta tomorrow.
